rationale: C11 plausibly supplied the core drafting template. Both directives delegate to the Secretary of Defense presidential authority to order reserve-component members to active duty without their consent, impose a maximum active-duty period, and separately reserve Coast Guard authority to the Secretary of the Treasury. These distinctive provisions occur in substantially the same sequence and language, with the child adapting the machinery to medical, dental, and allied specialists under amended statutory authority. C13 and C17 strongly supply subject-matter language concerning those specialist categories and statutory priorities, but they do not match the child's delegation structure as closely as C11.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there is hereby delegated to the Secretary of Defense ... the authority vested in the President ... to order to active duty in the armed forces of the United States, with or without their consent, those members of the reserve components
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby delegated to the Secretary of Defense the authority vested in the President ... to order into the active military or naval service of the United States ... with or without their consent, any or all members ... of any or all Reserve components
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared delegation language and the same substantive authority to compel reserve members into active service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The period of active duty that any such person may be required to perform shall not exceed (a) twenty-four months
shared_material.parent_excerpt: for a period not to exceed twenty-four months
shared_material.explanation: Both impose a maximum active-duty term; the child elaborates it into graduated limits based on prior service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: So much of the said authority of the President as relates to members of the Coast Guard Reserve may be exercised by the Secretary of the Treasury when the Coast Guard is operating as a service In the Department of the Treasury.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: so much of the authority of the President ... as relates to any Reserve component of the United States Coast Guard ... is hereby delegated to the Secretary of the Treasury.
shared_material.explanation: The same specialized Coast Guard/Treasury carveout strongly indicates reuse of concrete administrative machinery.
